name: Spinach Rice
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs less cloudy. Soak for 20 minutes, drain and measure fresh cooking water.
Heat oil in a heavy saucepan, sizzle cumin and prepare the flavour base.
Wash and finely chop spinach. Wilt it in the spice oil for 3 minutes, then add peas before adding rice.
Add drained rice, cumin if not yet used, salt and measured water. Bring to a boil, cover tightly and simmer over low heat for 12–15 minutes until the liquid is absorbed.
Switch off the heat and rest covered for 10 minutes without stirring. If the grains are still firm, sprinkle in a little boiling water and steam for another 3 minutes.
Fluff gently with a fork and serve hot. Cool any rice intended for later use promptly and refrigerate rather than leaving it warm on the counter.
tips: Taste at the end and adjust salt, heat and consistency before serving.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
